summary: Backend services for an internal administration platform supporting operational visibility, drive-health monitoring, and customer-support workflows.
highlights: Developed and maintained Spring Boot backend services for the internal administration platform, supporting operational visibility, drive-health monitoring, and customer-support workflows.

Modernized enterprise services from Java 8 to Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.x; enhanced JWT-based authentication, standardized Swagger (OpenAPI) documentation across microservices for security compliance, validated APIs via Postman, and containerized services with Docker.
Implemented and maintained data-processing workflows using AWS S3, Athena, Hive, and Parquet, orchestrated through Apache Airflow DAGs and scheduled jobs.
Supported automated end-to-end pipeline stages covering data ingestion, analytics, AI predictions, alerts, and email notifications across multiple tenants.
Optimized PostgreSQL queries through B-tree indexing, execution-plan analysis, and SQL tuning for join-heavy and anti-join queries; contributed to the PostgreSQL 14-to-17 upgrade.

Designed Java-side mappings for nested data structures and custom DTOs using Hibernate and Spring Data JPA; resolved production issues involving JSON/XML serialization, timestamp parsing, ORM mappings, and long-running SQL queries.
